name: Lotte Chilsung Beverage Co., Ltd.
summary: Lotte Chilsung Beverage Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells soft drinks, liquor, fruit/vegetable drinks, grain drinks, and food and other beverages in Korea, the Philippines, Pakistan, the United States, Japan, China, Myanmar, Singapore, and Russia. It operates through Beverage and Liquor segments. The company offers beverages, including carbonated drinks, juices, coffee, tea, functional drinks, spring water, and other products; and liquor products, including soju, beer, spirits, fruit liquor, cheongju, wine, and cooking wine products.
